name: The Sea Explorer
summary: Exploring the jaw-dropping US east coast by foot and by boat
description: Get ready to discover stunning coastal landscapes through a dynamic mix of hiking and boating. This journey takes you off the beaten path to explore vibrant beachside communities, historical islands, and pristine shorelines. Led by professional guides, the expedition is tailored for active travelers who enjoy a mix of outdoor exploration, scenic transits, and local island culture.

name: The Forest Hiker
summary: Breathtaking hike through the Canadian Banff National Park
description: Disappear into the wilderness on a scenic, accessible trek through majestic pine forests, towering peaks, and pristine glacial landscapes. Starting from the charming town of Banff, Alberta, this nature-focused journey is tailored for hikers who want to experience the raw beauty of Canada's wilderness at a comfortable pace. Led by experienced guides, the tour combines peaceful trail walks with unforgettable mountain vistas.

name: The Snow Adventurer
summary: Exciting adventure in the snow with snowboarding and skiing
description: Experience the thrill of winter in the breathtaking mountains of Colorado. Starting in the legendary alpine town of Aspen, this adventure takes you through some of the region's most exciting skiing and snowboarding destinations. Explore the steep slopes and deep powder bowls of Aspen Highlands before heading to Beaver Creek, where challenging downhill runs and beautiful mountain scenery await. Guided by experienced mountain professionals, this expedition offers an unforgettable combination of adrenaline, adventure, and spectacular alpine landscapes.

startLocation.address: 3663 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109, USA

name: The Park Camper
summary: Breathing in Nature in America's most spectacular National Parks
description: Disappear into the raw beauty of the American desert and canyonlands on an unforgettable outdoor adventure designed to reconnect you with nature. Setting off on a scenic circuit across diverse ecosystems, this expedition is tailored for nature lovers who want to experience iconic landscapes up close through a mix of rewarding trail hikes and wilderness exploration. Led by professional guides, the journey takes you from towering sandstone cliffs and mesmerizing slot canyons to the vast expanse of the high desert, offering an incredible blend of rugged terrain and breathtaking stargazing opportunities.

name: The City Wanderer
summary: Living the life of Wanderlust in the US' most beatiful cities
description: Dive into the heart of America's most celebrated cities on an accessible, multi-day metropolitan journey crafted for urban adventurers and culture seekers. Setting off on a cross-country circuit, this tour is tailored for those who want to experience legendary landmarks, diverse neighborhoods, and distinct local vibes at a comfortable, leisurely pace. Led by professional guides, the expedition seamlessly connects the bustling streets, historic architecture, and scenic coastal skylines of major cultural capitals, offering an unforgettable taste of classic American city life.

name: The Sports Lover
summary: Surfing, skating, parajumping, rock climbing and more, all in one tour
description: Push your physical boundaries on an action-packed, multi-day adrenaline rush that brings together the absolute best of extreme outdoor sports. Crafting a high-intensity circuit through diverse terrain, this advanced expedition is tailored specifically for thrill-seekers and athletes looking to conquer the elements by land, air, and water. Led by professional adventure guides, the journey transitions seamlessly from technical coastal breaks and rugged rock faces to intense whitewater rapids and sky-high drops, offering the ultimate bucket-list experience for action sports lovers.

name: The Star Gazer
summary: The most remote and stunningly beautiful places for seeing the night sky
description: Escape the bright lights of civilization on a multi-day journey dedicated to witnessing the raw majesty of the universe. This mid-level outdoor expedition targets ultra-remote wilderness destinations renowned for their lack of light pollution and crystal-clear atmospheric conditions. Led by professional guides, the itinerary blends moderate daytime trail exploration with unforgettable nocturnal viewing sessions, offering travelers a rare chance to view brilliant constellations, the Milky Way, and deep-space wonders above some of the country's most dramatic natural geological formations.

name: The Northern Lights
summary: Enjoy the Northern Lights in one of the best places in the world
description: Step into a magical winter wonderland on an accessible, multi-day retreat centered around the ultimate night-sky spectacle. This relaxing getaway is tailored for travelers who want to experience the breathtaking beauty of the subarctic wilderness without grueling physical demands. Led by experienced guides, the itinerary is optimized to maximize your chances of witnessing the brilliant, dancing curtains of the aurora borealis while enjoying cozy, scenic northern hospitality.

name: The Wine Taster
summary: Exquisite wines, scenic views, exclusive barrel tastings,  and much more
description: Unwind on a relaxing, luxury-focused tour through rolling valley hillsides and celebrated vineyards. Crafted for wine enthusiasts and culinary travelers alike, this easy-paced getaway offers an exclusive look into the art of winemaking. Led by expert hosts, the journey features unique barrel tastings, scenic estate strolls, and private cellar tours, providing a deeply immersive and sophisticated taste of the region's finest pours.
